title: Open stabilizers for geometric etale lifts
statement: Under the field hypotheses of the geometric point over Spec K, any monoid homomorphism to endomorphisms of the geometric etale fibre functor satisfying the extension precomposition formula has open stabilizers for each geometric lift.

proof.text: The construction extends field automorphisms and acts by precomposition; finite separable residue fields ensure independence and openness.

mathlib_searches.query: Galois action on geometric etale lifts

lean.statement:
theorem galoisPointAction_open_stabilizers
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (ρ : Gal(Ks/K) →* End (pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber)
    (hρ : ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
      (_ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
      (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X),
      ((ρ g).app X x).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left) :
    ∀ (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X),
      IsOpen {g : Gal(Ks/K) | (ρ g).app X x = x}
